triage.kind_span: The Fund is issuing transferable rights (“Rights”) to its common shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 20, 2021 (the “Record Date”) entitling the holders of these Rights to subscribe (the “Offer”) for an aggregate of 5,812,247 common shares

subject_names.span: Aberdeen Income Credit Strategies Fund (the “Fund”) is a diversified, closed-end management investment company.

subject_tickers.span: The Fund’s Common Shares trade under the symbol “ACP.”

security_class.span: entitling the holders of these Rights to subscribe (the “Offer”) for an aggregate of 5,812,247 common shares of beneficial interest

rights_per_share.span: will receive one Right for each outstanding Common Share owned on the Record Date

rights_per_new_share.span: The Rights entitle the holders to purchase one new Common Share for every three Rights held (1 for 3).

price_reference.span: a formula equal to 92.5% of the average of the last reported sales price of a Common Share on the NYSE on the Expiration Date

price_pct.span: a formula equal to 92.5% of the average of the last reported sales price of a Common Share on the NYSE on the Expiration Date

price_floor_pct_nav.span: If, however, the Formula Price is less than 87% of the Fund’s NAV per Common Share at the close of trading on the NYSE on the Expiration Date, then the Subscription Price will be 87% of the Fund’s NAV per Common Share

record_date.span: to its common shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 20, 2021 (the “Record Date”)

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on June 16, 2021, unless extended as described in this Prospectus Supplement (the “Expiration Date”).

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE under the symbol “ACP.RT” during the course of the Offer.

over_subscription.span: This is known as the “over-subscription privilege” (the “Over-Subscription Privilege”).

max_new_shares.span: The Fund is issuing to Record Date Shareholders transferable Rights to subscribe for an aggregate of 5,812,247 Common Shares.

notes: Single document (seq=1), 424B2 prospectus supplement dated May 20, 2021 (to prospectus dated April 27, 2021) for a transferable 1-for-3 rights offering (rights trade on NYSE as ACP.RT). Subscription price = 92.5% of the average last reported sales price on the Expiration Date and the four preceding trading days, but not less than 87% of NAV per share at the close on the Expiration Date: coded as price_reference=market, price_pct=92.5, price_floor_pct_nav=87. No secondary over-allotment / share increase stated; max_new_shares = 5,812,247. Holders of fewer than three shares may subscribe for one full share. Subscription period May 20, 2021 to June 16, 2021 unless extended (only one expiration date stated). Estimated subscription price $11.11.
